topic: Reservation Hatao Andolan protest in Delhi
sentiment: 40% critical of reservation/supportive of protest, 35% supportive of reservation/opposed to protest, 25% mixed/neutral
summary: Users posted about an ongoing anti-reservation demonstration at Jantar Mantar with calls for merit-based systems and equality, including videos of crowds and a journalist reporting intimidation during coverage. Counter-posts defended reservation policies, highlighted attacks on protesters or media, and questioned the movement's motives as divisive. Separate threads linked the debate to broader complaints about education quality, NEET issues, and government priorities like Vande Mataram campaigns. A few unrelated posts covered trains, Rahul Gandhi events, or unrelated personal stories but drew far less engagement.
